## GLM (logistic regression) Stepwise Selection based on p-value

```{r}
# --------------------------------------------------------------------
# COMPLETE STEPWISE SELECTION CODE WITH CALIBRATION ON FULL DATASET
# --------------------------------------------------------------------

# Load required packages
if (!require(pROC)) {
  install.packages("pROC")
  library(pROC)
}

if (!require(PRROC)) {
  install.packages("PRROC")
  library(PRROC)
}

if (!require(writexl)) {
  install.packages("writexl")
  library(writexl)
}

if (!require(Usmile)) {
  install.packages("Usmile")
  library(Usmile)
}

# --------------------------------------------------------------------
# HELPER FUNCTIONS
# --------------------------------------------------------------------

get_n_informative <- function(data) {
  if ("Class" %in% names(data)) {
    informative_vars <- grep("^V[0-9]+$", names(data), value = TRUE)
    if (length(informative_vars) > 0) {
      return(min(3, length(informative_vars)))
    }
  }
  return(5)
}

get_predictor_variables <- function(data) {
  # For synthetic scenarios
  if ("Class" %in% names(data) && any(grepl("^V[0-9]+$", names(data)))) {
    return(paste0("V", 1:10))
  }
  # For real heart disease scenario
  if ("disease" %in% names(data)) {
    predictor_vars <- setdiff(names(data), "disease")
    return(predictor_vars)
  }
  # Default for other scenarios
  return(paste0("V", 1:10))
}

calculate_auc_pr <- function(predictions, labels) {
  tryCatch({
    if (length(unique(labels)) < 2) {
      return(NA)
    }
    if (!is.numeric(labels)) {
      labels <- as.numeric(as.factor(labels)) - 1
    }
    labels <- as.integer(labels)
    pr_curve <- pr.curve(scores.class0 = predictions[labels == 1],
                         scores.class1 = predictions[labels == 0],
                         curve = TRUE)
    return(pr_curve$auc.integral)
  }, error = function(e) {
    return(NA)
  })
}

calculate_cllr <- function(scores, labels) {
  scores <- pmin(pmax(scores, 1e-6), 1 - 1e-6)
  
  true_cases <- as.logical(labels)
  false_cases <- !true_cases
  
  costs_true <- -log2(scores[true_cases])
  costs_false <- -log2(1 - scores[false_cases])
  
  cllr <- (sum(costs_true) + sum(costs_false)) / length(scores)
  
  return(cllr)
}

calculate_youden_metrics <- function(predictions, labels) {
  tryCatch({
    roc_obj <- pROC::roc(labels, predictions, quiet = TRUE)
    youden_index <- which.max(roc_obj$sensitivities + roc_obj$specificities - 1)
    youden_threshold <- roc_obj$thresholds[youden_index]
    binary_preds <- ifelse(predictions >= youden_threshold, 1, 0)
    
    TP <- sum(binary_preds == 1 & labels == 1)
    TN <- sum(binary_preds == 0 & labels == 0)
    FP <- sum(binary_preds == 1 & labels == 0)
    FN <- sum(binary_preds == 0 & labels == 1)
    
    sensitivity <- ifelse((TP + FN) > 0, TP / (TP + FN), 0)
    specificity <- ifelse((TN + FP) > 0, TN / (TN + FP), 0)
    precision <- ifelse((TP + FP) > 0, TP / (TP + FP), 0)
    f1_score <- ifelse((precision + sensitivity) > 0, 
                       2 * (precision * sensitivity) / (precision + sensitivity), 0)
    
    return(list(
      sensitivity = sensitivity,
      specificity = specificity,
      precision = precision,
      f1_score = f1_score
    ))
  }, error = function(e) {
    return(list(
      sensitivity = NA,
      specificity = NA,
      precision = NA,
      f1_score = NA
    ))
  })
}

# --------------------------------------------------------------------
# CORRECT CROSS-VALIDATION WITH CALIBRATION ON FULL DATASET
# --------------------------------------------------------------------

cross_validate_model_with_calibration <- function(data, formula_ref, formula_new = NULL, n_folds = 10) {
  set.seed(123)
  n <- nrow(data)
  folds <- sample(rep(1:n_folds, length.out = n))
  
  all_predictions_ref <- numeric(n)
  all_predictions_new <- numeric(n)
  all_labels <- numeric(n)
  fold_assignments <- numeric(n)
  
  # Determine target variable name
  target_var <- ifelse("Class" %in% names(data), "Class", "disease")
  
  # STEP 1: PERFORM CROSS-VALIDATION (RAW PREDICTIONS)
  for (fold in 1:n_folds) {
    train_indices <- which(folds != fold)
    test_indices <- which(folds == fold)
    
    train_data <- data[train_indices, ]
    test_data <- data[test_indices, ]
    
    # Reference model
    if (length(all.vars(formula_ref)) == 1) { # Only intercept
      # Empty model - use mean from training data
      if (is.factor(train_data[[target_var]])) {
        ref_prob <- mean(as.numeric(train_data[[target_var]]) - 1)
      } else {
        ref_prob <- mean(train_data[[target_var]])
      }
      all_predictions_ref[test_indices] <- rep(ref_prob, length(test_indices))
    } else {
      # Model with variables
      model_ref <- glm(formula_ref, data = train_data, family = binomial)
      all_predictions_ref[test_indices] <- predict(model_ref, newdata = test_data, type = "response")
    }
    
    # New model (if provided)
    if (!is.null(formula_new)) {
      model_new <- glm(formula_new, data = train_data, family = binomial)
      all_predictions_new[test_indices] <- predict(model_new, newdata = test_data, type = "response")
    }
    
    fold_assignments[test_indices] <- fold
    
    # Save labels
    if (is.factor(test_data[[target_var]])) {
      all_labels[test_indices] <- as.numeric(test_data[[target_var]]) - 1
    } else {
      all_labels[test_indices] <- as.numeric(test_data[[target_var]])
    }
  }
  
  # STEP 2: CALIBRATION ON ENTIRE DATASET
  if (!is.null(formula_new)) {
    # Calibration of reference model (only if not empty)
    if (length(all.vars(formula_ref)) > 1) {
      calibration_ref <- glm(all_labels ~ all_predictions_ref, family = binomial)
      all_predictions_ref_calibrated <- predict(calibration_ref, type = "response")
    } else {
      all_predictions_ref_calibrated <- all_predictions_ref
    }
    
    # Calibration of new model
    calibration_new <- glm(all_labels ~ all_predictions_new, family = binomial)
    all_predictions_new_calibrated <- predict(calibration_new, type = "response")
    
    return(list(
      predictions_ref = all_predictions_ref_calibrated,
      predictions_new = all_predictions_new_calibrated,
      labels = all_labels,
      folds = fold_assignments,
      predictions_ref_raw = all_predictions_ref,
      predictions_new_raw = all_predictions_new
    ))
  } else {
    # Only reference model
    if (length(all.vars(formula_ref)) > 1) {
      calibration_ref <- glm(all_labels ~ all_predictions_ref, family = binomial)
      all_predictions_ref_calibrated <- predict(calibration_ref, type = "response")
    } else {
      all_predictions_ref_calibrated <- all_predictions_ref
    }
    
    return(list(
      predictions_ref = all_predictions_ref_calibrated,
      labels = all_labels,
      folds = fold_assignments,
      predictions_ref_raw = all_predictions_ref
    ))
  }
}

# --------------------------------------------------------------------
# MODEL COMPARISON WITH CALIBRATION
# --------------------------------------------------------------------

compare_models_with_cv_calibrated <- function(data, base_vars, candidate_var, method = "auc", n_folds = 10) {
  target_var <- ifelse("Class" %in% names(data), "Class", "disease")
  
  if (length(base_vars) > 0) {
    formula_ref <- as.formula(paste(target_var, "~", paste(base_vars, collapse = " + ")))
  } else {
    formula_ref <- as.formula(paste(target_var, "~ 1"))
  }
  
  formula_new <- as.formula(paste(target_var, "~", paste(c(base_vars, candidate_var), collapse = " + ")))
  
  cv_results <- cross_validate_model_with_calibration(data, formula_ref, formula_new, n_folds)
  
  if (method == "auc") {
    return(compare_auc(cv_results$predictions_ref, cv_results$predictions_new, cv_results$labels))
  } else {
    n_vars_base <- length(base_vars)
    n_vars_new <- length(c(base_vars, candidate_var))
    return(compare_usmile(cv_results$predictions_ref, cv_results$predictions_new, cv_results$labels, method, n_vars_base, n_vars_new))
  }
}

compare_auc <- function(pred_base, pred_new, labels) {
  tryCatch({
    auc_base <- as.numeric(pROC::auc(pROC::roc(labels, pred_base, quiet = TRUE)))
    auc_new <- as.numeric(pROC::auc(pROC::roc(labels, pred_new, quiet = TRUE)))
    improvement <- auc_new - auc_base
    
    roc_base <- pROC::roc(labels, pred_base, quiet = TRUE)
    roc_new <- pROC::roc(labels, pred_new, quiet = TRUE)
    delong_test <- pROC::roc.test(roc_base, roc_new, method = "delong", alternative = "less")
    
    return(list(improvement = improvement, p_value = delong_test$p.value))
  }, error = function(e) {
    return(list(improvement = 0, p_value = 1))
  })
}

compare_usmile <- function(pred_base, pred_new, labels, method, n_vars_base, n_vars_new) {
  tryCatch({
    comparison_data <- data.frame(
      y = labels,
      p_ref = pred_base,
      p = pred_new
    )
    
    n_vars_diff <- n_vars_new - n_vars_base
    
    usmile_results <- UScalc_raw(comparison_data, y_coef = "rLR", n_vars_diff)
    
    if (method == "usmile_overall") {
      improvement <- usmile_results$Y_overall
      p_value <- usmile_results$p_Y_overall
    } else if (method == "usmile_event") {
      improvement <- usmile_results$netto_Y_event
      p_value <- usmile_results$p_Y_event
    } else if (method == "usmile_nonev") {
      improvement <- usmile_results$netto_Y_nonev
      p_value <- usmile_results$p_Y_nonev
    } else {
      improvement <- 0
      p_value <- 1
    }
    
    return(list(improvement = improvement, p_value = p_value))
    
  }, error = function(e) {
    return(list(improvement = 0, p_value = 1))
  })
}

# --------------------------------------------------------------------
# STEPWISE SELECTION FUNCTIONS (MODIFIED WITH CALIBRATION)
# --------------------------------------------------------------------

bidirectional_stepwise_selection_calibrated <- function(data, method = "auc", max_vars = 10, 
                                                       p_value_enter = 0.05, p_value_remove = 0.1) {
  available_vars <- get_predictor_variables(data)
  selected_vars <- character(0)
  improvement <- TRUE
  iteration <- 0
  history <- list()
  
  cat("=== Method:", toupper(method), "===\n")
  cat("Entry p-value threshold:", p_value_enter, "| Removal p-value threshold:", p_value_remove, "\n")
  
  while (improvement && length(selected_vars) <= max_vars && iteration < 20) {
    iteration <- iteration + 1
    improvement <- FALSE
    cat("Iteration", iteration, "- Current variables:", 
        if(length(selected_vars) > 0) paste(selected_vars, collapse = ", ") else "none", "\n")
    
    # STEP 1: TRY TO ADD A VARIABLE
    if (length(selected_vars) < max_vars) {
      candidate_vars <- setdiff(available_vars, selected_vars)
      
      if (length(candidate_vars) > 0) {
        best_forward <- find_best_forward_variable_calibrated(data, selected_vars, candidate_vars, method, p_value_enter)
        
        if (!is.null(best_forward$var)) {
          selected_vars <- c(selected_vars, best_forward$var)
          cat(">>> ADDED:", best_forward$var, "| p-value:", round(best_forward$p_value, 4), 
              "| improvement:", round(best_forward$improvement, 4), "\n")
          improvement <- TRUE
          
          history[[length(history) + 1]] <- list(
            iteration = iteration,
            action = "ADD",
            variable = best_forward$var,
            p_value = best_forward$p_value,
            improvement = best_forward$improvement,
            selected_vars = paste(selected_vars, collapse = ", ")
          )
          next
        }
      }
    }
    
    # STEP 2: TRY TO REMOVE A VARIABLE
    if (length(selected_vars) >= 1) {
      worst_backward <- find_worst_backward_variable_calibrated(data, selected_vars, method, p_value_remove)
      
      if (!is.null(worst_backward$var)) {
        selected_vars <- setdiff(selected_vars, worst_backward$var)
        cat(">>> REMOVED:", worst_backward$var, "| p-value loss:", round(worst_backward$p_value, 4), 
            "| deterioration:", round(worst_backward$deterioration, 4), "\n")
        improvement <- TRUE
        
        history[[length(history) + 1]] <- list(
          iteration = iteration,
          action = "REMOVE",
          variable = worst_backward$var,
          p_value = worst_backward$p_value,
          improvement = -worst_backward$deterioration,
          selected_vars = paste(selected_vars, collapse = ", ")
        )
      }
    }
  }
  
  cat("Final model - Selected variables:", 
      if(length(selected_vars) > 0) paste(selected_vars, collapse = ", ") else "none", "\n")
  cat("Number of variables:", length(selected_vars), "\n")
  
  return(list(
    selected_vars = selected_vars,
    history = history,
    iterations = iteration
  ))
}

find_best_forward_variable_calibrated <- function(data, base_vars, candidate_vars, method, p_value_threshold) {
  best_p_value <- 1
  best_var <- NULL
  best_improvement <- -Inf
  
  for (var in candidate_vars) {
    comparison <- compare_models_with_cv_calibrated(data, base_vars, var, method)
    
    # CORRECTED CONDITION: p-value < threshold AND improvement > 0
    if (!is.na(comparison$p_value) && comparison$p_value < best_p_value && 
        !is.na(comparison$improvement) && comparison$improvement > 0) {
      best_p_value = comparison$p_value
      best_var = var
      best_improvement = comparison$improvement
    }
  }
  
  # CORRECTED CONDITION: only if improvement > 0
  if (best_p_value < p_value_threshold && !is.na(best_improvement) && best_improvement > 0) {
    return(list(var = best_var, p_value = best_p_value, improvement = best_improvement))
  } else {
    return(list(var = NULL, p_value = best_p_value, improvement = best_improvement))
  }
}

find_worst_backward_variable_calibrated <- function(data, current_vars, method, p_value_threshold) {
  if (length(current_vars) <= 1) {
    return(list(var = NULL, p_value = NA, deterioration = NA))
  }
  
  worst_p_value <- -1
  worst_var <- NULL
  worst_deterioration <- Inf
  
  for (var in current_vars) {
    reduced_vars <- setdiff(current_vars, var)
    comparison <- compare_models_with_cv_calibrated(data, reduced_vars, var, method)
    
    # CORRECTED CONDITION: p-value > threshold AND deterioration < 0 (actual deterioration)
    if (!is.na(comparison$p_value) && comparison$p_value > worst_p_value && 
        !is.na(comparison$improvement) && comparison$improvement < 0) {
      worst_p_value = comparison$p_value
      worst_var = var
      worst_deterioration = -comparison$improvement
    }
  }
  
  # CORRECTED CONDITION: only if deterioration > 0 (acceptable loss)
  if (!is.na(worst_p_value) && worst_p_value > p_value_threshold && 
      !is.na(worst_deterioration) && worst_deterioration > 0) {
    return(list(var = worst_var, p_value = worst_p_value, deterioration = worst_deterioration))
  } else {
    return(list(var = NULL, p_value = worst_p_value, deterioration = worst_deterioration))
  }
}

# --------------------------------------------------------------------
# FUNCTIONS FOR COLLECTING TEST PREDICTIONS (MODIFIED)
# --------------------------------------------------------------------

collect_test_predictions_calibrated <- function(data, selected_vars_history, scenario_name, method_name) {
  all_predictions <- list()
  
  for (step in 1:length(selected_vars_history)) {
    current_step <- selected_vars_history[[step]]
    current_vars <- current_step$selected_vars
    
    if (current_vars != "" && current_vars != "none") {
      selected_vars_list <- strsplit(current_vars, ", ")[[1]]
      
      if (length(selected_vars_list) > 0) {
        target_var <- ifelse("Class" %in% names(data), "Class", "disease")
        formula_current <- as.formula(paste(target_var, "~", paste(selected_vars_list, collapse = " + ")))
        
        cv_results <- cross_validate_model_with_calibration(data, formula_current)
        
        step_predictions <- data.frame(
          scenario = scenario_name,
          method = method_name,
          step = step,
          action = current_step$action,
          variable = current_step$variable,
          selected_vars = current_vars,
          n_vars = length(selected_vars_list),
          observation_id = 1:length(cv_results$predictions_ref),
          true_label = cv_results$labels,
          predicted_prob = cv_results$predictions_ref,
          predicted_prob_raw = cv_results$predictions_ref_raw,
          fold = cv_results$folds
        )
        
        all_predictions[[step]] <- step_predictions
      }
    }
  }
  
  if (length(all_predictions) > 0) {
    return(do.call(rbind, all_predictions))
  } else {
    return(NULL)
  }
}

collect_final_predictions_calibrated <- function(final_results, scenarios) {
  final_predictions_list <- list()
  
  for (scenario_name in names(final_results)) {
    data <- scenarios[[scenario_name]]
    
    for (method_name in names(final_results[[scenario_name]])) {
      result <- final_results[[scenario_name]][[method_name]]
      selected_vars <- result$selected_vars
      
      if (selected_vars != "" && selected_vars != "none") {
        selected_vars_list <- strsplit(selected_vars, ", ")[[1]]
        target_var <- ifelse("Class" %in% names(data), "Class", "disease")
        formula_final <- as.formula(paste(target_var, "~", paste(selected_vars_list, collapse = " + ")))
        
        cv_results <- cross_validate_model_with_calibration(data, formula_final)
        
        final_pred_df <- data.frame(
          scenario = scenario_name,
          method = method_name,
          selected_vars = selected_vars,
          n_vars = length(selected_vars_list),
          observation_id = 1:length(cv_results$predictions_ref),
          true_label = cv_results$labels,
          predicted_prob = cv_results$predictions_ref,
          predicted_prob_raw = cv_results$predictions_ref_raw,
          fold = cv_results$folds
        )
        
        final_predictions_list[[paste(scenario_name, method_name)]] <- final_pred_df
      }
    }
  }
  
  if (length(final_predictions_list) > 0) {
    return(do.call(rbind, final_predictions_list))
  } else {
    return(NULL)
  }
}

# --------------------------------------------------------------------
# FINAL MODEL EVALUATION (MODIFIED WITH I COEFFICIENTS)
# --------------------------------------------------------------------

evaluate_final_model_calibrated <- function(data, selected_vars, scenario_name, method_name) {
  target_var <- ifelse("Class" %in% names(data), "Class", "disease")
  
  if (length(selected_vars) == 0) {
    formula_final <- as.formula(paste(target_var, "~ 1"))
  } else {
    formula_final <- as.formula(paste(target_var, "~", paste(selected_vars, collapse = " + ")))
  }
  
  cv_results <- cross_validate_model_with_calibration(data, formula_final)
  
  auc_value <- NA
  tryCatch({
    roc_obj <- pROC::roc(cv_results$labels, cv_results$predictions_ref, quiet = TRUE)
    auc_value <- as.numeric(pROC::auc(roc_obj))
  }, error = function(e) {
    warning(paste("AUC error:", e$message))
  })
  
  auc_pr_value <- calculate_auc_pr(cv_results$predictions_ref, cv_results$labels)
  cllr_value <- calculate_cllr(cv_results$predictions_ref, cv_results$labels)
  youden_metrics <- calculate_youden_metrics(cv_results$predictions_ref, cv_results$labels)
  
  null_formula <- as.formula(paste(target_var, "~ 1"))
  null_cv <- cross_validate_model_with_calibration(data, null_formula)
  n_vars_diff <- length(selected_vars)
  
  comparison_data <- data.frame(
    y = cv_results$labels,
    p_ref = null_cv$predictions_ref,
    p = cv_results$predictions_ref
  )
  
  # UPDATED: Extract both Y and I coefficients
  tryCatch({
    usmile_coefs <- UScalc_raw(comparison_data, y_coef = "rLR", n_vars_diff)
    usmile_overall <- usmile_coefs$Y_overall
    usmile_event <- usmile_coefs$netto_Y_event
    usmile_nonev <- usmile_coefs$netto_Y_nonev
    # NEW: I coefficients
    usmile_I_overall <- usmile_coefs$I_overall
    usmile_I_event <- usmile_coefs$netto_I_event
    usmile_I_nonev <- usmile_coefs$netto_I_nonev
  }, error = function(e) {
    usmile_overall <- NA
    usmile_event <- NA
    usmile_nonev <- NA
    usmile_I_overall <- NA
    usmile_I_event <- NA
    usmile_I_nonev <- NA
  })
  
  return(data.frame(
    scenario = scenario_name,
    method = method_name,
    selected_vars = if(length(selected_vars) > 0) paste(selected_vars, collapse = ", ") else "none",
    n_vars = length(selected_vars),
    auc_roc = auc_value,
    auc_pr = auc_pr_value,
    cllr = cllr_value,
    f1_score = youden_metrics$f1_score,
    sensitivity = youden_metrics$sensitivity,
    specificity = youden_metrics$specificity,
    precision = youden_metrics$precision,
    # Y coefficients
    usmile_netto_overall = usmile_overall,
    usmile_netto_event = usmile_event,
    usmile_netto_nonev = usmile_nonev,
    # NEW: I coefficients
    usmile_I_overall = usmile_I_overall,
    usmile_I_event = usmile_I_event,
    usmile_I_nonev = usmile_I_nonev,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  ))
}

# --------------------------------------------------------------------
# MAIN ANALYSIS WITH CALIBRATION FOR ALL 6 SCENARIOS
# --------------------------------------------------------------------

# SCENARIO DEFINITIONS FOR ALL 6 SCENARIOS
scenarios <- list(
  low = data_low_power,
  medium = data_med_power, 
  high = data_high_power,
  imbalanced = data_imbalanced,
  imbalanced_asym = data_imbalanced_asym,  # NEW: Added asymmetric scenario
  real_heart = data_real_heart
)

final_results_calibrated <- list()
selection_history_calibrated <- list()
all_test_predictions_calibrated <- list()

for (scenario_name in names(scenarios)) {
  cat("SCENARIO:", scenario_name, "\n")
  
  data <- scenarios[[scenario_name]]
  scenario_results <- list()
  scenario_predictions <- list()
  
  # Method 1: AUC
  result_auc <- bidirectional_stepwise_selection_calibrated(data, "auc", p_value_enter = 0.05, p_value_remove = 0.1)
  eval_auc <- evaluate_final_model_calibrated(data, result_auc$selected_vars, scenario_name, "AUC")
  scenario_results[["AUC"]] <- eval_auc
  selection_history_calibrated[[paste(scenario_name, "AUC")]] <- result_auc$history
  
  pred_auc <- collect_test_predictions_calibrated(data, result_auc$history, scenario_name, "AUC")
  if (!is.null(pred_auc)) {
    scenario_predictions[["AUC"]] <- pred_auc
  }
  
  # Method 2: U-smile Overall
  result_overall <- bidirectional_stepwise_selection_calibrated(data, "usmile_overall", p_value_enter = 0.05, p_value_remove = 0.1)
  eval_overall <- evaluate_final_model_calibrated(data, result_overall$selected_vars, scenario_name, "U-smile Overall")
  scenario_results[["U-smile Overall"]] <- eval_overall
  selection_history_calibrated[[paste(scenario_name, "U-smile Overall")]] <- result_overall$history
  
  pred_overall <- collect_test_predictions_calibrated(data, result_overall$history, scenario_name, "U-smile Overall")
  if (!is.null(pred_overall)) {
    scenario_predictions[["U-smile Overall"]] <- pred_overall
  }
  
  # Method 3: U-smile Event
  result_event <- bidirectional_stepwise_selection_calibrated(data, "usmile_event", p_value_enter = 0.05, p_value_remove = 0.1)
  eval_event <- evaluate_final_model_calibrated(data, result_event$selected_vars, scenario_name, "U-smile Event")
  scenario_results[["U-smile Event"]] <- eval_event
  selection_history_calibrated[[paste(scenario_name, "U-smile Event")]] <- result_event$history
  
  pred_event <- collect_test_predictions_calibrated(data, result_event$history, scenario_name, "U-smile Event")
  if (!is.null(pred_event)) {
    scenario_predictions[["U-smile Event"]] <- pred_event
  }
  
  # Method 4: U-smile Nonevent
  result_nonev <- bidirectional_stepwise_selection_calibrated(data, "usmile_nonev", p_value_enter = 0.05, p_value_remove = 0.1)
  eval_nonev <- evaluate_final_model_calibrated(data, result_nonev$selected_vars, scenario_name, "U-smile Nonevent")
  scenario_results[["U-smile Nonevent"]] <- eval_nonev
  selection_history_calibrated[[paste(scenario_name, "U-smile Nonevent")]] <- result_nonev$history
  
  pred_nonev <- collect_test_predictions_calibrated(data, result_nonev$history, scenario_name, "U-smile Nonevent")
  if (!is.null(pred_nonev)) {
    scenario_predictions[["U-smile Nonevent"]] <- pred_nonev
  }
  
  final_results_calibrated[[scenario_name]] <- scenario_results
  all_test_predictions_calibrated[[scenario_name]] <- scenario_predictions
}

# --------------------------------------------------------------------
# PREPARE DATA FOR EXCEL
# --------------------------------------------------------------------

# Results summary
summary_list_calibrated <- list()
for (scenario_name in names(final_results_calibrated)) {
  for (method_name in names(final_results_calibrated[[scenario_name]])) {
    summary_list_calibrated[[paste(scenario_name, method_name)]] <- final_results_calibrated[[scenario_name]][[method_name]]
  }
}

final_summary_calibrated <- do.call(rbind, summary_list_calibrated)
rownames(final_summary_calibrated) <- NULL

# Variable selection precision analysis
precision_analysis_calibrated <- data.frame()

for (scenario_name in names(scenarios)) {
  n_informative <- get_n_informative(scenarios[[scenario_name]])
  
  if (scenario_name != "real_heart") {
    true_vars <- paste0("V", 1:n_informative)
  } else {
    true_vars <- get_predictor_variables(scenarios[[scenario_name]])
  }
  
  scenario_data <- final_summary_calibrated[final_summary_calibrated$scenario == scenario_name, ]
  
  for (i in 1:nrow(scenario_data)) {
    method_name <- scenario_data$method[i]
    selected_vars_str <- scenario_data$selected_vars[i]
    
    if (selected_vars_str != "" && selected_vars_str != "none") {
      selected_vars_list <- strsplit(selected_vars_str, ", ")[[1]]
      correct_vars <- sum(selected_vars_list %in% true_vars)
      precision <- correct_vars / length(selected_vars_list)
      recall <- correct_vars / length(true_vars)
      f1_measure <- ifelse((precision + recall) > 0, 
                           round(2 * precision * recall / (precision + recall), 3), 0)
    } else {
      precision <- 0
      recall <- 0
      f1_measure <- 0
    }
    
    precision_analysis_calibrated <- rbind(precision_analysis_calibrated, data.frame(
      scenario = scenario_name,
      method = method_name,
      true_informative_vars = paste(true_vars, collapse = ", "),
      selected_vars = selected_vars_str,
      n_selected = ifelse(selected_vars_str != "" && selected_vars_str != "none", 
                         length(strsplit(selected_vars_str, ", ")[[1]]), 0),
      n_correct = correct_vars,
      precision = round(precision, 3),
      recall = round(recall, 3),
      f1_measure = f1_measure,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ))
  }
}

# Selection history
history_df_calibrated <- data.frame()
for (history_name in names(selection_history_calibrated)) {
  history_data <- selection_history_calibrated[[history_name]]
  if (length(history_data) > 0) {
    for (i in 1:length(history_data)) {
      step <- history_data[[i]]
      history_df_calibrated <- rbind(history_df_calibrated, data.frame(
        scenario_method = history_name,
        iteration = step$iteration,
        action = step$action,
        variable = step$variable,
        p_value = step$p_value,
        improvement = step$improvement,
        selected_vars = step$selected_vars,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      ))
    }
  }
}

# Process predictions
process_predictions_list_calibrated <- list()
for (scenario_name in names(all_test_predictions_calibrated)) {
  for (method_name in names(all_test_predictions_calibrated[[scenario_name]])) {
    process_predictions_list_calibrated[[paste(scenario_name, method_name)]] <- all_test_predictions_calibrated[[scenario_name]][[method_name]]
  }
}

if (length(process_predictions_list_calibrated) > 0) {
  process_predictions_calibrated <- do.call(rbind, process_predictions_list_calibrated)
} else {
  process_predictions_calibrated <- data.frame()
}

# Final model predictions
final_predictions_calibrated <- collect_final_predictions_calibrated(final_results_calibrated, scenarios)

# --------------------------------------------------------------------
# SAVE TO EXCEL WITH NEW NAMES
# --------------------------------------------------------------------

excel_data_calibrated <- list(
  "Results_Summary" = final_summary_calibrated,
  "Variable_Selection_Precision" = precision_analysis_calibrated,
  "Selection_History" = history_df_calibrated
)

if (nrow(process_predictions_calibrated) > 0) {
  excel_data_calibrated[["Process_Predictions"]] <- process_predictions_calibrated
}

if (!is.null(final_predictions_calibrated) && nrow(final_predictions_calibrated) > 0) {
  excel_data_calibrated[["Final_Model_Predictions"]] <- final_predictions_calibrated
}


write_xlsx(excel_data_calibrated, path = "selection_steps_GLM.xlsx")

# --------------------------------------------------------------------
# ADDITIONAL SAVE WITH NEW NAMES
# --------------------------------------------------------------------

selection_steps_GLM_results <- final_results_calibrated
selection_steps_GLM_summary <- final_summary_calibrated
selection_steps_GLM_precision <- precision_analysis_calibrated
selection_steps_GLM_history <- selection_history_calibrated
selection_steps_GLM_process_pred <- process_predictions_calibrated
selection_steps_GLM_final_pred <- final_predictions_calibrated
save(selection_steps_GLM_results, selection_steps_GLM_summary, selection_steps_GLM_precision, 
     selection_steps_GLM_history, selection_steps_GLM_process_pred, selection_steps_GLM_final_pred, 
     scenarios, file = "selection_steps_GLM.RData")

# --------------------------------------------------------------------
# SUMMARY
# --------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("STEPWISE SELECTION ANALYSIS WITH CALIBRATION COMPLETED!\n")
cat("Results saved in files:\n")
cat("- selection_steps_GLM.xlsx\n")
cat("- selection_steps_GLM.RData\n")

```

## RF (random forest) Forward Selection based on effect size

```{r}
# --------------------------------------------------------------------
# COMPLETE RANDOM FOREST FORWARD SELECTION WITH EFFECT SIZE THRESHOLD
# --------------------------------------------------------------------

# Load required packages
if (!require(randomForest)) {
  install.packages("randomForest")
  library(randomForest)
}

if (!require(pROC)) {
  install.packages("pROC")
  library(pROC)
}

if (!require(PRROC)) {
  install.packages("PRROC")
  library(PRROC)
}

if (!require(writexl)) {
  install.packages("writexl")
  library(writexl)
}

if (!require(Usmile)) {
  install.packages("Usmile")
  library(Usmile)
}

# --------------------------------------------------------------------
# HELPER FUNCTIONS
# --------------------------------------------------------------------

get_predictor_variables <- function(data) {
  if ("Class" %in% names(data) && any(grepl("^V[0-9]+$", names(data)))) {
    return(paste0("V", 1:10))
  }
  if ("disease" %in% names(data)) {
    predictor_vars <- setdiff(names(data), "disease")
    return(predictor_vars)
  }
  return(paste0("V", 1:10))
}

calculate_auc_pr <- function(predictions, labels) {
  tryCatch({
    if (length(unique(labels)) < 2) {
      return(NA)
    }
    if (!is.numeric(labels)) {
      labels <- as.numeric(as.factor(labels)) - 1
    }
    labels <- as.integer(labels)
    pr_curve <- pr.curve(scores.class0 = predictions[labels == 1],
                         scores.class1 = predictions[labels == 0],
                         curve = TRUE)
    return(pr_curve$auc.integral)
  }, error = function(e) {
    return(NA)
  })
}

calculate_cllr <- function(scores, labels) {
  scores <- pmin(pmax(scores, 1e-6), 1 - 1e-6)
  
  true_cases <- as.logical(labels)
  false_cases <- !true_cases
  
  costs_true <- -log2(scores[true_cases])
  costs_false <- -log2(1 - scores[false_cases])
  
  cllr <- (sum(costs_true) + sum(costs_false)) / length(scores)
  
  return(cllr)
}

calculate_youden_metrics <- function(predictions, labels) {
  tryCatch({
    roc_obj <- pROC::roc(labels, predictions, quiet = TRUE)
    youden_index <- which.max(roc_obj$sensitivities + roc_obj$specificities - 1)
    youden_threshold <- roc_obj$thresholds[youden_index]
    binary_preds <- ifelse(predictions >= youden_threshold, 1, 0)
    
    TP <- sum(binary_preds == 1 & labels == 1)
    TN <- sum(binary_preds == 0 & labels == 0)
    FP <- sum(binary_preds == 1 & labels == 0)
    FN <- sum(binary_preds == 0 & labels == 1)
    
    sensitivity <- ifelse((TP + FN) > 0, TP / (TP + FN), 0)
    specificity <- ifelse((TN + FP) > 0, TN / (TN + FP), 0)
    precision <- ifelse((TP + FP) > 0, TP / (TP + FP), 0)
    f1_score <- ifelse((precision + sensitivity) > 0, 
                       2 * (precision * sensitivity) / (precision + sensitivity), 0)
    
    return(list(
      sensitivity = sensitivity,
      specificity = specificity,
      precision = precision,
      f1_score = f1_score
    ))
  }, error = function(e) {
    return(list(
      sensitivity = NA,
      specificity = NA,
      precision = NA,
      f1_score = NA
    ))
  })
}

# --------------------------------------------------------------------
# CROSS-VALIDATION AND MODEL COMPARISON FUNCTIONS
# --------------------------------------------------------------------

cross_validate_rf_with_calibration <- function(data, selected_vars_ref, selected_vars_new = NULL, n_folds = 10) {
  set.seed(123)
  
  target_var <- ifelse("Class" %in% names(data), "Class", "disease")
  data[[target_var]] <- as.factor(data[[target_var]])
  
  n <- nrow(data)
  folds <- sample(rep(1:n_folds, length.out = n))
  
  all_predictions_ref <- numeric(n)
  all_predictions_new <- numeric(n)
  all_labels <- numeric(n)
  fold_assignments <- numeric(n)
  
  for (fold in 1:n_folds) {
    train_indices <- which(folds != fold)
    test_indices <- which(folds == fold)
    
    train_data <- data[train_indices, ]
    test_data <- data[test_indices, ]
    
    if (length(selected_vars_ref) == 0) {
      ref_prob <- mean(as.numeric(train_data[[target_var]]) - 1)
      all_predictions_ref[test_indices] <- rep(ref_prob, length(test_indices))
    } else {
      formula_ref <- as.formula(paste(target_var, "~", paste(selected_vars_ref, collapse = " + ")))
      rf_ref <- randomForest(formula_ref, data = train_data, ntree = 250)
      all_predictions_ref[test_indices] <- predict(rf_ref, newdata = test_data, type = "prob")[, 2]
    }
    
    if (!is.null(selected_vars_new)) {
      formula_new <- as.formula(paste(target_var, "~", paste(selected_vars_new, collapse = " + ")))
      rf_new <- randomForest(formula_new, data = train_data, ntree = 250)
      all_predictions_new[test_indices] <- predict(rf_new, newdata = test_data, type = "prob")[, 2]
    }
    
    fold_assignments[test_indices] <- fold
    all_labels[test_indices] <- as.numeric(test_data[[target_var]]) - 1
  }
  
  if (!is.null(selected_vars_new)) {
    if (length(selected_vars_ref) > 0) {
      calibration_ref <- glm(all_labels ~ all_predictions_ref, family = binomial)
      all_predictions_ref_calibrated <- predict(calibration_ref, type = "response")
    } else {
      all_predictions_ref_calibrated <- all_predictions_ref
    }
    
    calibration_new <- glm(all_labels ~ all_predictions_new, family = binomial)
    all_predictions_new_calibrated <- predict(calibration_new, type = "response")
    
    return(list(
      predictions_ref = all_predictions_ref_calibrated,
      predictions_new = all_predictions_new_calibrated,
      labels = all_labels,
      folds = fold_assignments,
      predictions_ref_raw = all_predictions_ref,
      predictions_new_raw = all_predictions_new
    ))
  } else {
    if (length(selected_vars_ref) > 0) {
      calibration_ref <- glm(all_labels ~ all_predictions_ref, family = binomial)
      all_predictions_ref_calibrated <- predict(calibration_ref, type = "response")
    } else {
      all_predictions_ref_calibrated <- all_predictions_ref
    }
    
    return(list(
      predictions_ref = all_predictions_ref_calibrated,
      labels = all_labels,
      folds = fold_assignments,
      predictions_ref_raw = all_predictions_ref
    ))
  }
}

compare_rf_models_with_cv_calibrated <- function(data, base_vars, candidate_var, method = "auc", n_folds = 10) {
  if (length(base_vars) > 0) {
    selected_vars_ref <- base_vars
  } else {
    selected_vars_ref <- character(0)
  }
  
  selected_vars_new <- c(base_vars, candidate_var)
  
  cv_results <- cross_validate_rf_with_calibration(data, selected_vars_ref, selected_vars_new, n_folds)
  
  if (method == "auc") {
    return(compare_auc_rf_original(cv_results$predictions_ref, cv_results$predictions_new, cv_results$labels))
  } else {
    n_vars_base <- length(base_vars)
    n_vars_new <- length(c(base_vars, candidate_var))
    return(compare_usmile_rf_original(cv_results$predictions_ref, cv_results$predictions_new, cv_results$labels, method, n_vars_base, n_vars_new))
  }
}

compare_auc_rf_original <- function(pred_base, pred_new, labels) {
  tryCatch({
    auc_base <- as.numeric(pROC::auc(pROC::roc(labels, pred_base, quiet = TRUE)))
    auc_new <- as.numeric(pROC::auc(pROC::roc(labels, pred_new, quiet = TRUE)))
    improvement <- auc_new - auc_base
    
    percentage_improvement <- ifelse(auc_base > 0, (improvement / auc_base) * 100, 0)
    
    return(list(
      improvement = improvement,
      percentage_improvement = percentage_improvement,
      base_value = auc_base,
      new_value = auc_new
    ))
  }, error = function(e) {
    return(list(improvement = 0, percentage_improvement = 0, base_value = 0, new_value = 0))
  })
}

compare_usmile_rf_original <- function(pred_base, pred_new, labels, method, n_vars_base, n_vars_new) {
  tryCatch({
    comparison_data <- data.frame(
      y = labels,
      p_ref = pred_base,
      p = pred_new
    )
    
    n_vars_diff <- n_vars_new - n_vars_base
    
    usmile_results <- UScalc_raw(comparison_data, y_coef = "rLR", n_vars_diff)
    
    if (method == "usmile_overall") {
      absolute_improvement <- usmile_results$Y_overall
    } else if (method == "usmile_event") {
      absolute_improvement <- usmile_results$netto_Y_event
    } else if (method == "usmile_nonev") {
      absolute_improvement <- usmile_results$netto_Y_nonev
    } else {
      absolute_improvement <- 0
    }
    
    percentage_improvement <- absolute_improvement * 100
    
    return(list(
      improvement = absolute_improvement,
      percentage_improvement = percentage_improvement,
      base_value = 0,
      new_value = absolute_improvement
    ))
  }, error = function(e) {
    return(list(improvement = 0, percentage_improvement = 0, base_value = 0, new_value = 0))
  })
}

# --------------------------------------------------------------------
# FORWARD SELECTION FUNCTIONS WITH EFFECT SIZE THRESHOLD
# --------------------------------------------------------------------

get_base_performance <- function(data, method) {
  return(0)
}

forward_selection_rf_effect_size <- function(data, method = "auc", max_vars = 10, effect_size_threshold = 2) {
  all_vars <- get_predictor_variables(data)
  selected_vars <- character(0)
  iteration <- 0
  history <- list()
  
  cat("=== RANDOM FOREST Forward Selection - Method:", toupper(method), "===\n")
  cat("Effect size threshold:", effect_size_threshold, "% improvement\n")
  cat("Starting with empty model\n")
  
  improvement <- TRUE
  base_performance <- get_base_performance(data, method)
  
  while (improvement && length(selected_vars) < max_vars && iteration < 15) {
    iteration <- iteration + 1
    improvement <- FALSE
    
    cat("Iteration", iteration, "- Current variables:", 
        if(length(selected_vars) > 0) paste(selected_vars, collapse = ", ") else "none", "\n")
    
    best_addition <- find_best_variable_by_effect_size(data, selected_vars, all_vars, method, effect_size_threshold, base_performance)
    
    if (!is.null(best_addition$var)) {
      selected_vars <- c(selected_vars, best_addition$var)
      cat(">>> ADDED:", best_addition$var, "| Improvement:", round(best_addition$improvement, 4), 
          "| Percentage:", round(best_addition$percentage_improvement, 2), "%\n")
      improvement = TRUE
      
      history[[length(history) + 1]] <- list(
        iteration = iteration,
        action = "ADD",
        variable = best_addition$var,
        improvement = best_addition$improvement,
        percentage_improvement = best_addition$percentage_improvement,
        base_value = best_addition$base_value,
        new_value = best_addition$new_value,
        selected_vars = paste(selected_vars, collapse = ", ")
      )
    } else {
      cat(">>> No variable provides sufficient improvement (≥", effect_size_threshold, "%)\n")
    }
  }
  
  cat("Final RF model - Selected variables (", length(selected_vars), "):", 
      if(length(selected_vars) > 0) paste(selected_vars, collapse = ", ") else "none", "\n")
  
  return(list(
    selected_vars = selected_vars,
    history = history,
    iterations = iteration
  ))
}

find_best_variable_by_effect_size <- function(data, base_vars, candidate_vars, method, effect_size_threshold, base_performance) {
  best_improvement <- -Inf
  best_var <- NULL
  best_percentage_improvement <- 0
  best_base_value <- 0
  best_new_value <- 0
  
  for (var in candidate_vars) {
    comparison <- compare_rf_models_with_cv_calibrated(data, base_vars, var, method)
    
    if (!is.na(comparison$percentage_improvement) && 
        comparison$percentage_improvement > best_improvement &&
        comparison$percentage_improvement >= effect_size_threshold) {
      best_improvement <- comparison$percentage_improvement
      best_var <- var
      best_percentage_improvement <- comparison$percentage_improvement
      best_base_value <- comparison$base_value
      best_new_value <- comparison$new_value
    }
  }
  
  if (!is.null(best_var)) {
    return(list(
      var = best_var,
      improvement = best_new_value - best_base_value,
      percentage_improvement = best_percentage_improvement,
      base_value = best_base_value,
      new_value = best_new_value
    ))
  } else {
    return(list(var = NULL))
  }
}

# --------------------------------------------------------------------
# FINAL MODEL EVALUATION FUNCTION
# --------------------------------------------------------------------

evaluate_final_model_rf_calibrated <- function(data, selected_vars, scenario_name, method_name) {
  target_var <- ifelse("Class" %in% names(data), "Class", "disease")
  
  data[[target_var]] <- as.factor(data[[target_var]])
  
  if (length(selected_vars) == 0) {
    selected_vars_ref <- character(0)
  } else {
    selected_vars_ref <- selected_vars
  }
  
  cv_results <- cross_validate_rf_with_calibration(data, selected_vars_ref)
  
  auc_value <- NA
  tryCatch({
    roc_obj <- pROC::roc(cv_results$labels, cv_results$predictions_ref, quiet = TRUE)
    auc_value <- as.numeric(pROC::auc(roc_obj))
  }, error = function(e) {
    warning(paste("AUC error:", e$message))
  })
  
  auc_pr_value <- calculate_auc_pr(cv_results$predictions_ref, cv_results$labels)
  cllr_value <- calculate_cllr(cv_results$predictions_ref, cv_results$labels)
  youden_metrics <- calculate_youden_metrics(cv_results$predictions_ref, cv_results$labels)
  
  null_cv <- cross_validate_rf_with_calibration(data, character(0))
  n_vars_diff <- length(selected_vars)
  
  comparison_data <- data.frame(
    y = cv_results$labels,
    p_ref = null_cv$predictions_ref,
    p = cv_results$predictions_ref
  )
  
  tryCatch({
    usmile_coefs <- UScalc_raw(comparison_data, y_coef = "rLR", n_vars_diff)
    usmile_overall <- usmile_coefs$Y_overall
    usmile_event <- usmile_coefs$netto_Y_event
    usmile_nonev <- usmile_coefs$netto_Y_nonev
    usmile_I_overall <- usmile_coefs$I_overall
    usmile_I_event <- usmile_coefs$netto_I_event
    usmile_I_nonev <- usmile_coefs$netto_I_nonev
  }, error = function(e) {
    usmile_overall <- NA
    usmile_event <- NA
    usmile_nonev <- NA
    usmile_I_overall <- NA
    usmile_I_event <- NA
    usmile_I_nonev <- NA
  })
  
  return(data.frame(
    scenario = scenario_name,
    method = method_name,
    selected_vars = if(length(selected_vars) > 0) paste(selected_vars, collapse = ", ") else "none",
    n_vars = length(selected_vars),
    auc_roc = auc_value,
    auc_pr = auc_pr_value,
    cllr = cllr_value,
    f1_score = youden_metrics$f1_score,
    sensitivity = youden_metrics$sensitivity,
    specificity = youden_metrics$specificity,
    precision = youden_metrics$precision,
    usmile_netto_overall = usmile_overall,
    usmile_netto_event = usmile_event,
    usmile_netto_nonev = usmile_nonev,
    usmile_I_overall = usmile_I_overall,
    usmile_I_event = usmile_I_event,
    usmile_I_nonev = usmile_I_nonev,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  ))
}

# --------------------------------------------------------------------
# MAIN ANALYSIS
# --------------------------------------------------------------------

load("classification_datasets.RData")

scenarios <- list(
  low = data_low_power,
  medium = data_med_power, 
  high = data_high_power,
  imbalanced = data_imbalanced,
  imbalanced_asym = data_imbalanced_asym,
  real_heart = data_real_heart
)

selection_steps_RF_results <- list()
selection_steps_RF_history <- list()

cat("STARTING RANDOM FOREST FORWARD SELECTION (2% THRESHOLD)\n")
cat("==================================================\n")
cat("Scenarios: low, medium, high, imbalanced, imbalanced_asym, real_heart\n")
cat("Methods: AUC, U-smile Overall, U-smile Event, U-smile Nonevent\n")
cat("Effect size threshold: 2% improvement required\n")
cat("==================================================\n")

for (scenario_name in names(scenarios)) {
  cat("\nSCENARIO:", scenario_name, "\n")
  cat("==================================================\n")
  
  data <- scenarios[[scenario_name]]
  scenario_results <- list()
  
  cat("Method: AUC (2% improvement threshold)\n")
  result_auc <- forward_selection_rf_effect_size(data, "auc", effect_size_threshold = 2)
  eval_auc <- evaluate_final_model_rf_calibrated(data, result_auc$selected_vars, scenario_name, "AUC")
  scenario_results[["AUC"]] <- eval_auc
  selection_steps_RF_history[[paste(scenario_name, "AUC")]] <- result_auc$history
  
  cat("Method: U-smile Overall (2% improvement threshold)\n")
  result_overall <- forward_selection_rf_effect_size(data, "usmile_overall", effect_size_threshold = 2)
  eval_overall <- evaluate_final_model_rf_calibrated(data, result_overall$selected_vars, scenario_name, "U-smile Overall")
  scenario_results[["U-smile Overall"]] <- eval_overall
  selection_steps_RF_history[[paste(scenario_name, "U-smile Overall")]] <- result_overall$history
  
  cat("Method: U-smile Event (2% improvement threshold)\n")
  result_event <- forward_selection_rf_effect_size(data, "usmile_event", effect_size_threshold = 2)
  eval_event <- evaluate_final_model_rf_calibrated(data, result_event$selected_vars, scenario_name, "U-smile Event")
  scenario_results[["U-smile Event"]] <- eval_event
  selection_steps_RF_history[[paste(scenario_name, "U-smile Event")]] <- result_event$history
  
  cat("Method: U-smile Nonevent (2% improvement threshold)\n")
  result_nonev <- forward_selection_rf_effect_size(data, "usmile_nonev", effect_size_threshold = 2)
  eval_nonev <- evaluate_final_model_rf_calibrated(data, result_nonev$selected_vars, scenario_name, "U-smile Nonevent")
  scenario_results[["U-smile Nonevent"]] <- eval_nonev
  selection_steps_RF_history[[paste(scenario_name, "U-smile Nonevent")]] <- result_nonev$history
  
  selection_steps_RF_results[[scenario_name]] <- scenario_results
  
  cat("Completed scenario:", scenario_name, "\n")
  cat("Selected variables by method:\n")
  for (method in names(scenario_results)) {
    cat("  ", method, ":", scenario_results[[method]]$selected_vars, "\n")
  }
}

# --------------------------------------------------------------------
# RESULTS PROCESSING AND SAVING
# --------------------------------------------------------------------

selection_steps_RF_summary <- list()
for (scenario_name in names(selection_steps_RF_results)) {
  for (method_name in names(selection_steps_RF_results[[scenario_name]])) {
    selection_steps_RF_summary[[paste(scenario_name, method_name)]] <- 
      selection_steps_RF_results[[scenario_name]][[method_name]]
  }
}

selection_steps_RF_summary_df <- do.call(rbind, selection_steps_RF_summary)
rownames(selection_steps_RF_summary_df) <- NULL

selection_steps_RF_precision <- data.frame()

for (scenario_name in names(scenarios)) {
  if (scenario_name == "low") {
    true_vars <- c("V1", "V2")
  } else if (scenario_name == "medium") {
    true_vars <- c("V1", "V2", "V3", "V4", "V5")
  } else if (scenario_name == "high") {
    true_vars <- c("V1", "V2", "V3", "V4", "V5", "V6", "V7", "V8")
  } else if (scenario_name %in% c("imbalanced", "imbalanced_asym")) {
    true_vars <- c("V1", "V2", "V3", "V4", "V5")
  } else if (scenario_name == "real_heart") {
    true_vars <- c("age", "sex", "cp", "bp", "chol", "glu", "ecg", "hr", "exang", "stde")
  }
  
  scenario_data <- selection_steps_RF_summary_df[selection_steps_RF_summary_df$scenario == scenario_name, ]
  
  for (i in 1:nrow(scenario_data)) {
    method_name <- scenario_data$method[i]
    selected_vars_str <- scenario_data$selected_vars[i]
    
    if (selected_vars_str != "" && selected_vars_str != "none") {
      selected_vars_list <- strsplit(selected_vars_str, ", ")[[1]]
      correct_vars <- sum(selected_vars_list %in% true_vars)
      precision <- correct_vars / length(selected_vars_list)
      recall <- correct_vars / length(true_vars)
      f1_measure <- ifelse((precision + recall) > 0, 
                           round(2 * precision * recall / (precision + recall), 3), 0)
    } else {
      precision <- 0
      recall <- 0
      f1_measure <- 0
    }
    
    selection_steps_RF_precision <- rbind(selection_steps_RF_precision, data.frame(
      scenario = scenario_name,
      method = method_name,
      true_informative_vars = paste(true_vars, collapse = ", "),
      selected_vars = selected_vars_str,
      n_selected = ifelse(selected_vars_str != "" && selected_vars_str != "none", 
                         length(strsplit(selected_vars_str, ", ")[[1]]), 0),
      n_correct = correct_vars,
      precision = round(precision, 3),
      recall = round(recall, 3),
      f1_measure = f1_measure,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ))
  }
}

selection_steps_RF_history_df <- data.frame()
for (history_name in names(selection_steps_RF_history)) {
  history_data <- selection_steps_RF_history[[history_name]]
  if (length(history_data) > 0) {
    for (i in 1:length(history_data)) {
      step <- history_data[[i]]
      selection_steps_RF_history_df <- rbind(selection_steps_RF_history_df, data.frame(
        scenario_method = history_name,
        iteration = step$iteration,
        action = step$action,
        variable = step$variable,
        improvement = step$improvement,
        percentage_improvement = step$percentage_improvement,
        base_value = step$base_value,
        new_value = step$new_value,
        selected_vars = step$selected_vars,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      ))
    }
  }
}

excel_data <- list(
  "Results_Summary" = selection_steps_RF_summary_df,
  "Variable_Selection_Precision" = selection_steps_RF_precision,
  "Selection_History" = selection_steps_RF_history_df
)

write_xlsx(excel_data, path = "selection_steps_RF.xlsx")

save(selection_steps_RF_results, selection_steps_RF_summary_df, selection_steps_RF_precision, 
     selection_steps_RF_history, selection_steps_RF_history_df, scenarios,
     file = "selection_steps_RF.RData")

cat("\nRANDOM FOREST FORWARD SELECTION COMPLETED!\n")
cat("Results saved to selection_steps_RF.xlsx and selection_steps_RF.RData\n")

```
