```{r}
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# COMPLETE MATRIX PLOTS FOR U-SMILE, ROC AND PR
# -------------------------------------------------------------------

create_complete_matrix_plots_calibrated <- function(scenario_number, method_number, model_type = "logistic regression", reference_type = "empty",
                                                   plot_width = 20, plot_height = 18, 
                                                   save_plot = TRUE, 
                                                   file_format = "png", 
                                                   dpi = 300,
                                                   compression = "lzw") {
  
  if (!require(ggplot2)) {
    install.packages("ggplot2")
    library(ggplot2)
  }
  if (!require(patchwork)) {
    install.packages("patchwork")
    library(patchwork)
  }
  if (!require(pROC)) {
    install.packages("pROC")
    library(pROC)
  }
  if (!require(PRROC)) {
    install.packages("PRROC")
    library(PRROC)
  }
  if (!require(Usmile)) {
    install.packages("Usmile")
    library(Usmile)
  }
  
  scenario_names <- c("low", "medium", "high", "imbalanced", "imbalanced_asym", "real_heart")
  method_names <- c("AUC", "U-smile Overall", "U-smile Event", "U-smile Nonevent")
  
  if (scenario_number < 1 | scenario_number > length(scenario_names)) {
    stop("Invalid scenario number. Available: 1-6")
  }
  
  if (method_number < 1 | method_number > length(method_names)) {
    stop("Invalid method number. Available: 1-4")
  }
  
  if (!model_type %in% c("logistic regression", "random forest")) {
    stop("Invalid model type. Available: logistic regression, random forest")
  }
  
  if (!file_format %in% c("png", "tiff", "jpg", "pdf")) {
    stop("Invalid file format. Available: png, tiff, jpg, pdf")
  }
  
  scenario_name <- scenario_names[scenario_number]
  method_name <- method_names[method_number]
  
  cat("Creating complete matrix plots for:\n")
  cat("Model:", model_type, "\n")
  cat("Scenario:", scenario_name, "(number", scenario_number, ")\n")
  cat("Method:", method_name, "(number", method_number, ")\n")
  cat("Reference:", ifelse(reference_type == "empty", "empty model", "previous model"), "\n")
  if (save_plot) {
    cat("Output:", file_format, "format,", dpi, "DPI,", plot_width, "x", plot_height, "cm\n")
  }
  
  if (!exists("scenarios")) {
    stop("Scenarios data not found. Please load classification datasets first.")
  }
  
  data <- scenarios[[scenario_name]]
  history_key <- paste(scenario_name, method_name)
  
  if (model_type == "logistic regression") {
    if (exists("selection_steps_GLM_history")) {
      selection_history <- selection_steps_GLM_history[[history_key]]
    } else {
      stop("logistic regression selection history not found. Run logistic regression selection first.")
    }
  } else if (model_type == "random forest") {
    if (exists("selection_steps_RF_history")) {
      selection_history <- selection_steps_RF_history[[history_key]]
    } else {
      stop("random forest selection history not found. Run random forest selection first.")
    }
  }
  
  if (is.null(selection_history)) {
    stop("No selection history for chosen scenario and method combination")
  }
  
  cat("Number of steps in history:", length(selection_history), "\n")
  
  step_data_list <- prepare_stepwise_data_with_cv_calibrated(data, selection_history, scenario_name, method_name, reference_type, model_type)
  
  if (length(step_data_list) == 0) {
    stop("No step-by-step data")
  }
  
  usmile_plots <- list()
  roc_plots <- list()
  pr_plots <- list()
  
  for (i in 1:length(step_data_list)) {
    step_data <- step_data_list[[i]]
    cat("Creating plots for step", i, "...\n")
    
    usmile_plot <- create_usmile_plot_improved_labels(step_data, i, method_name, reference_type, selection_history, model_type)
    usmile_plots[[i]] <- usmile_plot
    
    roc_plot <- create_roc_matrix_plot(step_data, i, method_name, reference_type, selection_history, model_type)
    roc_plots[[i]] <- roc_plot
    
    pr_plot <- create_pr_matrix_plot(step_data, i, method_name, reference_type, selection_history, model_type)
    pr_plots[[i]] <- pr_plot
  }
  
  n_plots <- length(usmile_plots)
  
  usmile_matrix <- wrap_plots(usmile_plots, ncol = n_plots, nrow = 1) +
    plot_annotation(
      title = paste0("U-smile Matrix: ", scenario_name, " - ", method_name),
      subtitle = paste0("Reference: ", ifelse(reference_type == "empty", "empty model", "previous model"),
                       " | Steps: ", n_plots),
      theme = theme(
        plot.title = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0.5),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0.5)
      )
    )
  
  roc_matrix <- wrap_plots(roc_plots, ncol = n_plots, nrow = 1)
  
  pr_matrix <- wrap_plots(pr_plots, ncol = n_plots, nrow = 1)
  
  complete_matrix <- usmile_matrix / roc_matrix / pr_matrix +
    plot_annotation(
      title = paste0("Stepwise selection of variables for the ", model_type, " model: ", scenario_name, " - ", method_name),
      theme = theme(
        plot.title = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0.5)
      )
    )
  
  print(complete_matrix)
  
  saved_files <- list()
  
  if (save_plot) {
    base_filename <- paste0(model_type, "_", scenario_name, "_", gsub(" ", "_", method_name), "_", reference_type)
    
    complete_filename <- paste0("complete_matrix_", base_filename, ".", file_format)
    
    if (file_format == "tiff") {
      ggsave(complete_filename, complete_matrix, 
             width = plot_width, height = plot_height, dpi = dpi,
             device = "tiff", compression = compression)
    } else if (file_format == "png") {
      ggsave(complete_filename, complete_matrix, 
             width = plot_width, height = plot_height, dpi = dpi,
             device = "png")
    } else if (file_format == "jpg") {
      ggsave(complete_filename, complete_matrix, 
             width = plot_width, height = plot_height, dpi = dpi,
             device = "jpeg")
    } else if (file_format == "pdf") {
      ggsave(complete_filename, complete_matrix, 
             width = plot_width, height = plot_height,
             device = "pdf")
    }
    
    cat("Complete matrix plot saved as:", complete_filename, "\n")
    saved_files$complete_matrix <- complete_filename
    
    individual_matrices <- list(
      usmile_matrix = usmile_matrix,
      roc_matrix = roc_matrix,
      pr_matrix = pr_matrix
    )
    
    matrix_names <- c("usmile_matrix", "roc_matrix", "pr_matrix")
    individual_heights <- c(6, 6, 6)
    
    for (i in 1:length(matrix_names)) {
      matrix_filename <- paste0(matrix_names[i], "_", base_filename, ".", file_format)
      
      if (file_format == "tiff") {
        ggsave(matrix_filename, individual_matrices[[i]], 
               width = plot_width, height = individual_heights[i], dpi = dpi,
               device = "tiff", compression = compression)
      } else if (file_format == "png") {
        ggsave(matrix_filename, individual_matrices[[i]], 
               width = plot_width, height = individual_heights[i], dpi = dpi,
               device = "png")
      } else if (file_format == "jpg") {
        ggsave(matrix_filename, individual_matrices[[i]], 
               width = plot_width, height = individual_heights[i], dpi = dpi,
               device = "jpeg")
      } else if (file_format == "pdf") {
        ggsave(matrix_filename, individual_matrices[[i]], 
               width = plot_width, height = individual_heights[i],
               device = "pdf")
      }
      
      saved_files[[matrix_names[i]]] <- matrix_filename
    }
    
    cat("Individual matrices saved with prefix:", base_filename, "\n")
    cat("File format:", file_format, "| DPI:", ifelse(file_format %in% c("png", "tiff", "jpg"), dpi, "N/A"), 
        "| Dimensions:", plot_width, "x", plot_height, "cm\n")
  } else {
    cat("Plot saving disabled. Set save_plot = TRUE to save files.\n")
  }
  
  return(list(
    complete_matrix = complete_matrix,
    usmile_matrix = usmile_matrix,
    roc_matrix = roc_matrix,
    pr_matrix = pr_matrix,
    individual_plots = list(
      usmile = usmile_plots,
      roc = roc_plots,
      pr = pr_plots
    ),
    step_data = step_data_list,
    model_type = model_type,
    scenario = scenario_name,
    method = method_name,
    reference_type = reference_type,
    n_steps = n_plots,
    saved_files = saved_files,
    plot_settings = list(
      width = plot_width,
      height = plot_height,
      file_format = file_format,
      dpi = dpi,
      compression = ifelse(file_format == "tiff", compression, "N/A")
    )
  ))
}

create_usmile_plot_improved_labels <- function(step_data, step_num, method_name, reference_type, selection_history, model_type = "logistic regression") {
  comparison_df <- step_data$comparison_df
  
  if (reference_type == "empty") {
    ref_vars <- 0
  } else {
    if (step_num == 1) {
      ref_vars <- 0
    } else {
      ref_vars <- step_data$n_vars - 1
    }
  }
  
  n_vars_diff <- step_data$n_vars - ref_vars
  
  plot_title <- create_correct_title(step_data, step_num, reference_type, selection_history)
  
  netto_nonev <- ifelse(!is.null(step_data$usmile$netto_Y_nonev), 
                       round(step_data$usmile$netto_Y_nonev, 3), NA)
  netto_event <- ifelse(!is.null(step_data$usmile$netto_Y_event), 
                       round(step_data$usmile$netto_Y_event, 3), NA)
  
  tryCatch({
    raw_data <- data.frame(
      y = comparison_df$y,
      p_ref = comparison_df$p_ref,
      p = comparison_df$p
    )
    
    # Determine crit parameter based on model type
    # For logistic regression: crit = 2 (conditional dotted/solid lines)
    # For random forest: crit = 0 (solid gray lines)
    crit_value <- ifelse(model_type == "logistic regression", 2, 0)
    
    usmile_plot <- USplot(
      raw_data = raw_data,
      y_coef = "rLR",
      n_vars_diff = n_vars_diff,
      crit = crit_value  # Use different crit values based on model type
    )
    
    # Extract the base plot from USplot
    improved_plot <- usmile_plot +
      labs(
        title = plot_title,
        x = "subgroups",
        y = "rLR"
      ) +
      scale_x_discrete(
        limits = c('nonev_be', 'nonev_wo', 'event_wo', 'event_be'),
        labels = c("0+", "0-", "1-", "1+")
      ) +
      annotate("text", x = 0.02, y = 0.98, 
               label = ifelse(!is.na(netto_nonev), paste0("rLR0=", netto_nonev), "rLR0=NA"),
               hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = 3, 
               color = "#0F3C78", fontface = "bold") +  
      annotate("text", x = 4.98, y = 0.98, 
               label = ifelse(!is.na(netto_event), paste0("rLR1=", netto_event), "rLR1=NA"),
               hjust = 1, vjust = 1, size = 3, 
               color = "#D51424", fontface = "bold") +  
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(
        plot.title = element_text(size = 10, hjust = 0.5),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 9),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 7),
        legend.position = "none"
      )
    
    return(improved_plot)
    
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("Error creating U-smile plot for step", step_num, ":", e$message, "\n")
    
    tryCatch({
      custom_usmile_plot <- create_custom_usmile_plot_clean(step_data, step_num, comparison_df, plot_title, netto_nonev, netto_event)
      return(custom_usmile_plot)
    }, error = function(e2) {
      cat("Error creating custom U-smile plot:", e2$message, "\n")
      
      fallback_plot <- ggplot(comparison_df, aes(x = p_ref, y = p, color = factor(y))) +
        geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 0.5) +
        geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray") +
        scale_color_manual(values = c("0" = "#0F3C78", "1" = "#D51424")) +
        annotate("text", x = 0.02, y = 0.98, 
                 label = ifelse(!is.na(netto_nonev), paste0("rLR0=", netto_nonev), "rLR0=NA"),
                 hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = 3, 
                 color = "#0F3C78", fontface = "bold") +
        annotate("text", x = 4.98, y = 0.98, 
                 label = ifelse(!is.na(netto_event), paste0("rLR1=", netto_event), "rLR1=NA"),
                 hjust = 1, vjust = 1, size = 3, 
                 color = "#D51424", fontface = "bold") +
        labs(
          title = plot_title,
          x = "subgroups",
          y = "rLR"
        ) +
        theme_minimal() +
        theme(
          plot.title = element_text(size = 9, hjust = 0.5),
          axis.title = element_text(size = 8),
          axis.text = element_text(size = 6),
          legend.position = "none"
        )
      
      return(fallback_plot)
    })
  })
}

create_custom_usmile_plot_clean <- function(step_data, step_num, comparison_df, plot_title, netto_nonev, netto_event) {
  plot_data <- data.frame(
    p_ref = comparison_df$p_ref,
    p_new = comparison_df$p,
    outcome = factor(comparison_df$y, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("Non-event", "Event"))
  )
  
  custom_plot <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = p_ref, y = p_new, color = outcome)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 1) +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray", linewidth = 0.5) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Non-event" = "#0F3C78", "Event" = "#D51424")) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), breaks = c(0, 0.5, 1)) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), breaks = c(0, 0.5, 1)) +
    annotate("text", x = 0.02, y = 0.98, 
             label = ifelse(!is.na(netto_nonev), paste0("rLR0=", netto_nonev), "rLR0=NA"),
             hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = 3, 
             color = "#0F3C78", fontface = "bold") +
    annotate("text", x = 0.98, y = 0.98, 
             label = ifelse(!is.na(netto_event), paste0("rLR1=", netto_event), "rLR1=NA"),
             hjust = 1, vjust = 1, size = 3, 
             color = "#D51424", fontface = "bold") +
    labs(
      title = plot_title,
      x = "subgroups",
      y = "rLR"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 10, hjust = 0.5),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 9),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 7),
      legend.position = "none"
    )
  
  return(custom_plot)
}

create_roc_matrix_plot <- function(step_data, step_num, method_name, reference_type, selection_history, model_type = "logistic regression") {
  comparison_df <- step_data$comparison_df
  
  plot_title <- ""
  
  tryCatch({
    roc_new <- pROC::roc(comparison_df$y, comparison_df$p, quiet = TRUE)
    auc_new <- as.numeric(pROC::auc(roc_new))
    
    show_two_curves <- TRUE
    
    if (reference_type == "empty" || step_num == 1) {
      show_two_curves <- FALSE
    } else {
      if (step_data$reference_vars == 0) {
        show_two_curves <- FALSE
      }
    }
    
    if (show_two_curves) {
      roc_ref <- pROC::roc(comparison_df$y, comparison_df$p_ref, quiet = TRUE)
      auc_ref <- as.numeric(pROC::auc(roc_ref))
      
      roc_data_ref <- data.frame(
        sensitivity = roc_ref$sensitivities,
        specificity = roc_ref$specificities,
        model = "Reference"
      )
      
      roc_data_new <- data.frame(
        sensitivity = roc_new$sensitivities,
        specificity = roc_new$specificities,
        model = "New"
      )
      
      roc_data <- rbind(roc_data_ref, roc_data_new)
      
      roc_plot <- ggplot(roc_data, aes(x = 1 - specificity, y = sensitivity, linetype = model)) +
        geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
        geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray") +
        scale_linetype_manual(values = c("Reference" = "dashed", "New" = "solid")) +
        coord_equal() +
        annotate("text", x = 0.95, y = 0.05, 
                 label = paste0("ΔAUC = ", round(auc_new - auc_ref, 3)),
                 hjust = 1, vjust = 0, size = 2.5, fontface = "bold", color = "black") +
        labs(
          title = plot_title,  
          x = "1 - Specificity",
          y = "Sensitivity",
          linetype = "Model"
        ) +
        theme_minimal() +
        theme(
          plot.title = element_blank(),  
          axis.title = element_text(size = 8),
          axis.text = element_text(size = 6),
          legend.position = "none"
        )
    } else {
      roc_data_new <- data.frame(
        sensitivity = roc_new$sensitivities,
        specificity = roc_new$specificities
      )
      
      roc_plot <- ggplot(roc_data_new, aes(x = 1 - specificity, y = sensitivity)) +
        geom_line(linewidth = 0.8, color = "black") +
        geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray") +
        coord_equal() +
        annotate("text", x = 0.95, y = 0.05, 
                 label = paste0("AUC = ", round(auc_new, 3)),
                 hjust = 1, vjust = 0, size = 2.5, fontface = "bold", color = "black") +
        labs(
          title = plot_title,
          x = "1 - Specificity",
          y = "Sensitivity"
        ) +
        theme_minimal() +
        theme(
          plot.title = element_blank(),  
          axis.title = element_text(size = 8),
          axis.text = element_text(size = 6)
        )
    }
    
    return(roc_plot)
    
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("Error creating ROC plot for step", step_num, ":", e$message, "\n")
    
    fallback_plot <- ggplot() +
      annotate("text", x = 0.5, y = 0.5, label = "ROC Error", size = 3) +
      labs(title = plot_title) +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(
        plot.title = element_blank(),  
        axis.title = element_blank(),
        axis.text = element_blank()
      )
    
    return(fallback_plot)
  })
}

create_pr_matrix_plot <- function(step_data, step_num, method_name, reference_type, selection_history, model_type = "logistic regression") {
  comparison_df <- step_data$comparison_df
  
  plot_title <- ""
  
  tryCatch({
    y_mean <- mean(comparison_df$y)
    
    pr_new <- PRROC::pr.curve(
      scores.class0 = comparison_df$p[comparison_df$y == 1],
      scores.class1 = comparison_df$p[comparison_df$y == 0],
      curve = TRUE
    )
    auprc_new <- pr_new$auc.integral
    
    show_two_curves <- TRUE
    
    if (reference_type == "empty" || step_num == 1) {
      show_two_curves <- FALSE
    } else {
      if (step_data$reference_vars == 0) {
        show_two_curves <- FALSE
      }
    }
    
    if (show_two_curves) {
      pr_ref <- PRROC::pr.curve(
        scores.class0 = comparison_df$p_ref[comparison_df$y == 1],
        scores.class1 = comparison_df$p_ref[comparison_df$y == 0],
        curve = TRUE
      )
      auprc_ref <- pr_ref$auc.integral
      
      pr_data_ref <- data.frame(
        recall = pr_ref$curve[, 1],
        precision = pr_ref$curve[, 2],
        model = "Reference"
      )
      
      pr_data_new <- data.frame(
        recall = pr_new$curve[, 1],
        precision = pr_new$curve[, 2],
        model = "New"
      )
      
      pr_data <- rbind(pr_data_ref, pr_data_new)
      
      pr_plot <- ggplot(pr_data, aes(x = recall, y = precision, linetype = model)) +
        geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
        scale_linetype_manual(values = c("Reference" = "dashed", "New" = "solid")) +
        geom_hline(yintercept = y_mean, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray", linewidth = 0.5) +
        annotate("text", x = 0.05, y = 0.05, 
                 label = paste0("ΔAUC = ", round(auprc_new - auprc_ref, 3)),
                 hjust = 0, vjust = 0, size = 2.5, fontface = "bold", color = "black") +
        labs(
          title = plot_title,
          x = "Recall",
          y = "Precision",
          linetype = "Model"
        ) +
        theme_minimal() +
        theme(
          plot.title = element_blank(),  
          axis.title = element_text(size = 8),
          axis.text = element_text(size = 6),
          legend.position = "none"
        )
    } else {
      pr_data_new <- data.frame(
        recall = pr_new$curve[, 1],
        precision = pr_new$curve[, 2]
      )
      
      pr_plot <- ggplot(pr_data_new, aes(x = recall, y = precision)) +
        geom_line(linewidth = 0.8, color = "black") +
        geom_hline(yintercept = y_mean, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray", linewidth = 0.5) +
        annotate("text", x = 0.05, y = 0.05, 
                 label = paste0("AUC = ", round(auprc_new, 3)),
                 hjust = 0, vjust = 0, size = 2.5, fontface = "bold", color = "black") +
        labs(
          title = plot_title,
          x = "Recall",
          y = "Precision"
        ) +
        theme_minimal() +
        theme(
          plot.title = element_blank(),  
          axis.title = element_text(size = 8),
          axis.text = element_text(size = 6)
        )
    }
    
    return(pr_plot)
    
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("Error creating PR plot for step", step_num, ":", e$message, "\n")
    
    fallback_plot <- ggplot() +
      annotate("text", x = 0.5, y = 0.5, label = "PR Error", size = 3) +
      labs(title = plot_title) +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(
        plot.title = element_blank(),  
        axis.title = element_blank(),
        axis.text = element_blank()
      )
    
    return(fallback_plot)
  })
}

create_correct_title <- function(step_data, step_num, reference_type, selection_history) {
  
  if (step_num == 1) {
    if (length(selection_history) >= 1) {
      first_step <- selection_history[[1]]
      if (!is.null(first_step$variable) && first_step$variable != "") {
        if (reference_type == "empty") {
          return(paste0("Step 1: ", first_step$variable))
        } else {
          return(paste0("Step 1: ", first_step$variable, "\n        vs NULL"))
        }
      }
    }
    if (reference_type == "empty") {
      return("Step 1: START")
    } else {
      return("Step 1: START\n        vs NULL")
    }
  }
  
  current_vars <- strsplit(step_data$selected_vars, ", ")[[1]]
  
  if (reference_type == "empty") {
    if (length(current_vars) > 0) {
      return(paste0("Step ", step_num, ": ", paste(current_vars, collapse = "+")))
    } else {
      return(paste0("Step ", step_num, ": NULL"))
    }
  } else {
    if (step_num > 1) {
      prev_step <- selection_history[[step_num - 1]]
      prev_vars <- strsplit(prev_step$selected_vars, ", ")[[1]]
      
      current_vars_str <- ifelse(length(current_vars) > 0, 
                                paste0("(", paste(current_vars, collapse = "+"), ")"), 
                                "NULL")
      prev_vars_str <- ifelse(length(prev_vars) > 0, 
                             paste0("(", paste(prev_vars, collapse = "+"), ")"), 
                             "NULL")
      
      return(paste0("Step ", step_num, ": ", current_vars_str, "\n        vs ", prev_vars_str))
    } else {
      return(paste0("Step ", step_num, ": START\n        vs NULL"))
    }
  }
}

prepare_stepwise_data_with_cv_calibrated <- function(data, selection_history, scenario_name, method_name, reference_type = "previous", model_type = "logistic regression") {
  step_data <- list()
  previous_vars <- character(0)
  
  for (step_num in 1:length(selection_history)) {
    current_step <- selection_history[[step_num]]
    current_vars_str <- current_step$selected_vars
    
    if (current_vars_str != "" && current_vars_str != "none") {
      current_vars <- strsplit(current_vars_str, ", ")[[1]]
      
      if (reference_type == "empty") {
        ref_vars <- character(0)
      } else {
        ref_vars <- previous_vars
      }
      
      metrics <- calculate_metrics_with_cv_calibrated(data, current_vars, step_num, method_name, reference_type, ref_vars, model_type)
      
      step_data[[step_num]] <- metrics
      previous_vars <- current_vars
    }
  }
  
  return(step_data)
}

calculate_metrics_with_cv_calibrated <- function(data, selected_vars, step_num, method_name, reference_type, prev_vars = NULL, model_type = "logistic regression") {
  
  target_var <- ifelse("Class" %in% names(data), "Class", "disease")
  
  if (length(selected_vars) > 0) {
    current_vars_list <- selected_vars
  } else {
    current_vars_list <- character(0)
  }
  
  if (reference_type == "empty" || is.null(prev_vars)) {
    ref_vars_list <- character(0)
  } else {
    if (length(prev_vars) > 0) {
      ref_vars_list <- prev_vars
    } else {
      ref_vars_list <- character(0)
    }
  }
  
  if (model_type == "logistic regression") {
    if (!exists("cross_validate_model_with_calibration")) {
      stop("logistic regression cross-validation function not found. Make sure logistic regression selection code is loaded.")
    }
    
    if (length(current_vars_list) > 0) {
      current_formula <- as.formula(paste(target_var, "~", paste(current_vars_list, collapse = " + ")))
    } else {
      current_formula <- as.formula(paste(target_var, "~ 1"))
    }
    
    if (length(ref_vars_list) > 0) {
      ref_formula <- as.formula(paste(target_var, "~", paste(ref_vars_list, collapse = " + ")))
    } else {
      ref_formula <- as.formula(paste(target_var, "~ 1"))
    }
    
    current_cv <- cross_validate_model_with_calibration(data, current_formula)
    ref_cv <- cross_validate_model_with_calibration(data, ref_formula)
    
    current_predictions <- current_cv$predictions_ref
    ref_predictions <- ref_cv$predictions_ref
    labels <- current_cv$labels
    
  } else if (model_type == "random forest") {
    if (!exists("cross_validate_rf_with_calibration")) {
      stop("random forest cross-validation function not found. Make sure new random forest selection code is loaded.")
    }
    
    current_cv <- cross_validate_rf_with_calibration(data, current_vars_list)
    ref_cv <- cross_validate_rf_with_calibration(data, ref_vars_list)
    
    current_predictions <- current_cv$predictions_ref
    ref_predictions <- ref_cv$predictions_ref
    labels <- current_cv$labels
  }
  
  n_obs <- length(labels)
  
  comparison_df <- data.frame(
    y = labels,
    p_ref = ref_predictions,
    p = current_predictions
  )
  
  n_vars_diff <- length(selected_vars) - length(prev_vars)
  
  results <- list(
    step = step_num,
    action = ifelse(step_num == 1, "START", ifelse(length(selected_vars) > length(prev_vars), "ADD", "REMOVE")),
    variable = ifelse(step_num == 1, "START", 
                     ifelse(length(selected_vars) > length(prev_vars), 
                            setdiff(selected_vars, prev_vars), 
                            setdiff(prev_vars, selected_vars))),
    selected_vars = paste(selected_vars, collapse = ", "),
    n_vars = length(selected_vars),
    reference_type = reference_type,
    reference_vars = length(prev_vars),
    comparison_df = comparison_df
  )
  
  tryCatch({
    raw_data <- data.frame(
      y = comparison_df$y,
      p_ref = comparison_df$p_ref,
      p = comparison_df$p
    )
    
    usmile_results <- UScalc_raw(raw_data, y_coef = "rLR", n_vars_diff)
    
    if (!is.null(usmile_results$Y_overall)) {
      results$usmile <- list(
        Y_overall = usmile_results$Y_overall,
        netto_Y_event = ifelse(!is.null(usmile_results$netto_Y_event), usmile_results$netto_Y_event, NA),
        netto_Y_nonev = ifelse(!is.null(usmile_results$netto_Y_nonev), usmile_results$netto_Y_nonev, NA),
        p_Y_overall = ifelse(!is.null(usmile_results$p_Y_overall), usmile_results$p_Y_overall, NA),
        p_Y_event = ifelse(!is.null(usmile_results$p_Y_event), usmile_results$p_Y_event, NA),
        p_Y_nonev = ifelse(!is.null(usmile_results$p_Y_nonev), usmile_results$p_Y_nonev, NA)
      )
    }
    
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("UScalc_raw error for step", step_num, ":", e$message, "\n")
    results$usmile <- list(
      Y_overall = NA, netto_Y_event = NA, netto_Y_nonev = NA,
      p_Y_overall = NA, p_Y_event = NA, p_Y_nonev = NA
    )
  })
  
  return(results)
}

calculate_cllr <- function(scores, labels) {
  scores <- pmin(pmax(scores, 1e-6), 1 - 1e-6)
  
  true_cases <- as.logical(labels)
  false_cases <- !true_cases
  
  costs_true <- -log2(scores[true_cases])
  costs_false <- -log2(1 - scores[false_cases])
  
  cllr <- (sum(costs_true) + sum(costs_false)) / length(scores)
  
  return(cllr)
}

create_quick_matrix_plots <- function(scenario_number = 4, method_number = 4, model_type = "logistic regression", reference_type = "empty",
                                     plot_width = 20, plot_height = 18, 
                                     save_plot = TRUE, 
                                     file_format = "png", 
                                     dpi = 300,
                                     compression = "lzw") {
  cat("Creating quick matrix plots...\n")
  
  results <- create_complete_matrix_plots_calibrated(
    scenario_number, method_number, model_type, reference_type,
    plot_width, plot_height, save_plot, file_format, dpi, compression
  )
  
  cat("\n=== ANALYSIS SUMMARY ===\n")
  cat("Model:", results$model_type, "\n")
  cat("Scenario:", results$scenario, "\n")
  cat("Method:", results$method, "\n")
  cat("Steps:", results$n_steps, "\n")
  
  if (results$n_steps > 0) {
    final_step <- results$step_data[[results$n_steps]]
    cat("Final variables:", final_step$selected_vars, "\n")
  }
  
  if (save_plot) {
    cat("Files saved:", length(results$saved_files), "\n")
    cat("Settings: Format =", results$plot_settings$file_format, 
        "| DPI =", results$plot_settings$dpi,
        "| Size =", results$plot_settings$width, "x", results$plot_settings$height, "cm\n")
  }
  
  return(results)
}
```
